earnings.title: Boeing Reports Third Quarter Results
highlights: Operating cash flow of $1.5 billion and free cash flow (non-GAAP)* of $0.5 billion
Total company backlog grew to a record $745 billion, including over 6,300 commercial airplanes

quotes.text: Recent milestones, including certification of the 737-7 and 737-10 and selection to design and build the Navy’s sixth-generation fighter aircraft, are important steps as we continue building on our progress.
quotes.by: Kelly Ortberg, Boeing president and chief executive officer

items.heading: We depend heavily on commercial airlines, subjecting us to unique risks.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: Market conditions have a significant impact on demand for our commercial aircraft and related services.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: We enter into firm fixed-price aircraft sales contracts with indexed price escalation clauses, which subjects us to losses if we have cost overruns or if increases in our costs exceed the applicable escalation rate.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: Our Commercial Airplanes business depends on our ability to maintain a healthy production system, ensure every airplane in our production system conforms to exacting specifications, achieve planned production rate targets, successfully develop and certify new aircraft or new derivative aircraft, and meet or exceed stringent performance and reliability standards.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: We must minimize disruption caused by production changes, achieve and maintain operational stability and implement productivity improvements to meet customer demand and maintain our profitability.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations

items.heading: Operational challenges impacting the production system for one or more of our commercial aircraft programs could result in additional production delays and/or failure to meet customer demand for new aircraft, either of which would negatively impact our revenues and operating margins.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
